Feature: Is there ergative alignment of flagging on first person pronouns?
Comment: First-person pronouns show ergative alignment.
curated_comment: Verified against Daguman 2004:81-82 (sec. 3.2.4, Table 3.6); analysis summary p.122 (Table 4.4). Value 1 confirmed. Personal pronouns have distinct absolutive (S/O) and ergative (A) sets across all persons: 1SG ABS gakul/=u vs ERG nakul/=ku; 1PL.EXC ABS gami vs ERG nami; 1PL.INC ABS gita vs ERG nita. Daguman: the absolutive set occurs as S/O, the ergative set as A. CAVEAT: theory-dependent. This is Daguman's ergative analysis of a Philippine-type (symmetrical-voice) language; under a symmetrical-voice analysis the same data need not be ergative. Coding is faithful to the cited source.
